# onepassword_secret (Ephemeral Resource)

Get a secret from 1Password.

Example:
```hcl
ephemeral "onepassword_secret" "db_password" {
  reference = "op://Engineering/Database/password"
}

output "db_password" {
  value     = ephemeral.onepassword_secret.db_password.value
  sensitive = true
}
```

Reference: https://developer.1password.com/docs/cli/secret-reference-syntax/



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `reference` (String) The secret reference to get the secret from.

### Read-Only

- `value` (String, Sensitive) The returned secret value.
